base_engine_semantics: v0.4 exact transition/replay/cap/terminal semantics retained; only pivot ordering is changed in the candidate wrapper process

selector.root_class_priority: If live roots exist, roots precede extensions exactly as in v0.4. Within roots order by (d_x, frozen root position).
selector.extension_class_priority: After roots, extensions order by (d_x, variable id).
selector.d_x: Number of canonical clauses containing +x or -x.

selector_lemma.name: MINIMUM_INCIDENCE_WITNESS_IS_CONSTRUCTIVELY_SELECTED
selector_lemma.statement: For a root state with r>0 live root variables and total literal incidence L, the v0.5 proof-selector returns a root x* with d_x*=min_x d_x<=floor(L/r).
proof: Each literal occurrence contributes exactly one to the incidence degree of its underlying live variable, hence sum_x d_x=L.
If every d_x were at least floor(L/r)+1, their sum would exceed L; therefore min_x d_x<=floor(L/r).

The candidate computes every d_x by exact syntactic clause scans and sorts roots by (d_x, frozen root position). Therefore its first root is exactly a minimum-incidence witness with deterministic tie-break.
selector_lemma.cost: O(L+r log r) comparison-model work on the explicit state; polynomial under the existing state envelope.

N_le_25_base.statement: Inherited pivot-order-independent cap availability: N<=24 is covered by the audited T/Smax/Uraw envelope; at N=25 the remaining roots have <=4 clauses and the proved small-clause invariant makes every ordinary pivot cap-safe.

proof: For N=26,r=9, every legitimate remaining root has L=25-r-m<=15<18=2r.
For N=26,r=10, every legitimate remaining root has L<=14<20=2r.
Thus floor(L/r)<=1. Every live variable has positive incidence, so the selected minimum-incidence root has d=1.
The proved degree-1 exact elimination creates no resolvent and reroots to local N'<=22<=25.

partition.result: Every continuing ordinary pivot is cap-safe by the proved small-clause invariant; selector choice is irrelevant.
Selector lemma gives d_x*<=2. Existing low-incidence proof gives an exact cap-safe transition with N'<=N-4; strong induction and cap monotonicity finish the residual.
N=1+m+L+r>=6+4r, hence r<=floor((N-6)/4). The already-proved exact T/Smax/Uraw recurrence is below N^2 for every such r throughout N=27..41.

N42_boundary.partition: All cases except r=9,m=5,L=27 are inherited from the N<=41 partition or r<=8 recurrence.
proof: If d_min<=2, the existing low-incidence N-minus-4 reroot applies to the actually selected pivot.
If d_min=3, all nine degrees equal 3 because their sum is 27.
For any selected degree-3 pivot: pure polarity is deletion-only; mixed polarity has split {1,2}. The proved generic raw bound yields B_x<=37.
After the selected exact step, live variables<=8 and state_units<=37. The already-proved tail recurrence 109,973,1053,297,81,21 remains below 42^2=1764 to the exact terminal range.

finite_frontier_theorem.name: V0_5_PROOF_SELECTOR_NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N42
finite_frontier_theorem.statement: For every legitimate canonical root input of normalized encoding size N<=42, the v0.5 proof-selector candidate has an ordinary exact cap-safe continuation covered by the inherited exact corridors; when the proof needs a low-incidence witness, the executed selector constructively chooses such a witness. Thus the selector gap identified in v0.4 is closed for this finite cap-availability frontier.

what_this_does_not_prove: It does not prove the same property for all N.
It does not prove root-phase HIGH_VOLUME_RESCUE_TOTALITY in the unbounded case.
It does not prove root-free v3 universal availability.
It does not prove universal GPEI/PIRC preservation.
next_exact_target: Run executable selector/regression CI, then advance beyond N=42 only with this explicit selector semantics or prove pivot-order independence. Freeze the first uncertified reachable cell without mutating theorem rules mid-run.
